listing.name: WinBack: Covert Operations (WinBack Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Windows port of WinBack: Covert Operations. Set it up with your original US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare your Windows copy
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Windows x64 ZIP into a writable folder. Use Windows 10 or 11 with Vulkan support. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if needed. Open WinBackRecompiled.exe and select your own big-endian WinBack USA .z64 (SHA-1 fa04477b321a95e1f7a2edcac5c09bfa6ef72041). The game verifies and keeps a copy in its folder.

warnings: Save through the game before quitting. The BASIC level-select option does not restore previously recorded checkpoint progress. The project reports limited testing beyond the first mission.
The project reports that this release can crash on exit.

references.title: Setup instructions for the inspected release

data_locations: ROM copy, settings.json, saves/ including Controller Pak and checkpoints, mods and renderer data in the game folder

presentation.manual_preparation: On first Play, select your own US WinBack Nintendo 64 game file in big-endian .z64 format. The game verifies and stores its copy inside the managed installation. Portcove preserves that copy, display settings and Controller Pak saves across compatible updates. Recorded checkpoints, mod files and renderer data stay with the runtime that created them. Runtime rollback carries current shared saves and does not rewind progress. Use Windows 10 or 11 with Vulkan and the x64 Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable.
